gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histologically or cytologically confirmed locally advanced/metastatic solid cancers.

candidate_evidence.quote: Primary objective is to evaluate safety and tolerability of KESONOTIDE™ as a monotherapy in participants with advanced/metastatic solid cancers.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Has failed standard of care or refused next line therapy at the present time

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Secondary objective is to characterise the pharmacokinetics of KESONOTIDE™.

role_evidence.quote: An Adaptive Phase I/II Study of KESONOTIDE™, a Novel hGIIA-vimentin Inhibitor, in Participants With Solid Tumours
A novel hGIIA-Vimentin Inhibitor: Phase I, dose escalation includes 4 increasing doses, 10mg, 30mg, 60mg and 120mg.

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational oral hGIIA (secreted phospholipase A2 group IIA)-vimentin inhibitor peptide
arms: Phase I, Single Arm, dose escalation
2 Arms of selected indication and recommended dose

coder_notes: Multi-cancer basket; GBM named in conditions ('Glioblastoma Multiforme' -> historical terminology). Registered interventions 'A novel hGIIA-Vimentin Inhibitor' and 'Dose expansion' both refer to KESONOTIDE, listed as one agent. Phase II 'may be as monotherapy or in combination with standard of care' (partners unspecified); regimen coded monotherapy based on the registered monotherapy objective, could be unclear. PK planned with sample type not stated -> unclear. PSA/CA15.3 mentioned as serum disease markers for non-GBM cancers; not molecular tumour biomarkers relevant here, not listed.
